svg.title: Piecewise-linear approximation of TC(E)
svg.desc: The true concave TC(E) curve overlaid with five chord segments connecting Barreto-doubling break points. One segment is highlighted to show how the convex combination of its two endpoints reconstructs a single (E, TC) point inside it.
svg.text: Piecewise-linear approximation of TC(E) — 5 segments, Barreto doubling

g.text: All other λᴸ, λᴿ pinned to 0
Gray curve: true TC(E). Blue chords: PWL approximation. Break points at j = 0..5 placed by
Barreto doubling — denser near origin where curvature is highest, sparse in the flat tail.
